finalBehavior: Applying configuration reconnects an existing live client even when AutoConnect=false. Initial unconnected manual startup remains manual.
Reconnect clears old memory/session/messages/sources/alerts/staged composer and background tracking; failure exposes disconnected error with no usable previous agent.
Every tracker retains an owned API context; old endpoint/user/key contexts cannot write to a newly selected endpoint or display its sources there.
Current admin logout propagates to the next same-connection background request; another endpoint's admin credential is never adopted.

A401/403 invalidates only the admin identity and authentication revision actually sent by that rejected request. A later authentication, including reusing the same key value, survives stale rejection.
Known HTTP authentication failures are localized without raw English .NET exception text; detailed exception remains diagnostic.
newAdminRegressionTests: Real deterministic HttpMessageHandler records X-Admin-Key removed after same-context logout.
Real deterministic handler records old-owner request stays on old endpoint with its original credential when active endpoint changes.
Held401 response released after authentication with a different key does not clear current authentication.
Held401 response released after authentication with the same key does not clear the newer authentication revision.
Rejected current credential is invalidated; equal credential text on another endpoint remains untouched.
